verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents streaming that updates applications in real time as features are changed or toggled, but only for the JavaScript and React SDKs and as part of the GrowthBook Proxy page. Flags can be toggled off per environment, including through an API endpoint, which supports the kill-switch half of the story. Missing for 10: streaming in non-JS/React SDKs, documented fast-polling intervals or propagation latency figures, and hands-on evidence that a toggled-off flag reaches connected SDKs within seconds.

support.subject: As a developer, flag changes propagate to connected SDKs in seconds via streaming or fast polling — a kill switch actually kills

citations.quote: Streaming - Updates your application in real-time as features are changed or toggled in GrowthBook (JavaScript and React only)
It turbocharges your GrowthBook implementation by providing speed, scalability, security, and real-time feature rollouts.
